key_insight: QPAT uses a learnable quantum generative prior during classical model training, aiming to improve predictions while keeping inference entirely classical.
engineering_relevance: The framework integrates with LSTMs, CNNs, and Transformers without requiring quantum hardware at inference time.
method: Use a Quantum Circuit Born Machine to supply a task-aligned, structured training prior.
Apply decoupled fitness-based scoring to guide prior learning.
Use stochastic Drop-Prior to implicitly distill quantum structure into classical weights.
evidence_signal: Across six benchmarks in forecasting, vision, and NLP, the abstract reports better predictive performance and cross-seed stability than classical backbones, with ablations favoring QPAT over random and classically learned priors.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify quantum training costs or establish a computational advantage over classical alternatives.
paper_title: QPAT: A Universal Quantum Machine Learning Framework for Quantum-Assisted Training and Classical Inference
